caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with four rounded feet and ornate decorative features. The chest has a main section that features three heart-shaped or scroll motifs outlined in dark brown, each filled with a lighter tan color and set against a greenish background. Above these motifs, there is a horizontal panel with text written in red and black on a white background, which includes the date "1776." Below the main section, there are three drawers each adorned with gold-colored, intricate handles or escutcheons. The right side of the chest shows a circular motif with a star design, with alternating red and blue segments, set in an oval field on a tan background. The overall wood color is a warm brown, with some areas shaded darker for depth. In the top left and right corners, there are pencil sketches of ornamental designs on square frames. In the bottom left corner, there is a scale marked “Scale 2" = 1'” with incremental lines. The artist’s signature, "L. Pearce," is at the bottom right of the main drawing.
title: Pa. German Chest
